post_hoc.item: bootstrap: synthetic private/SPCX idiosyncratic draws demeaned (bug fix after the first run)
post_hoc.why: a finite Gaussian sample carries a sample-mean drift (venture idio ~50%/yr over 750 days: SE ~29%/yr), which pushed bootstrap medians above the prior means; demeaning restores the declared 're-centred on prior means'
